title: Runtime Annotations and Deferred Evaluation
summary: Python 3.14 evaluates annotations lazily, so forward references need no quotes, and annotationlib reads them as values, forward references or source text. Build a JSON-Schema-like generator from dataclass annotations that resolves forward references and quoted strings, which field.type does not.

resources.label: PEP 649: Deferred Evaluation Of Annotations Using Descriptors
